description: Frame-time drops while the camera flies over a town: pans over 8 nearby lots at 30 m (20 s a pass, 4 passes) inside a 2-minute measured window, the case where most drops of frame-stability-tour happen. Nothing edited or saved. The background frame limit is lifted; run with -Profiler Frames, or the inside variant (Developer build) for the mod's own frame timeline, whose last two minutes then hold the pan.
